youtube.title: Why Airplane Windows Have A Tiny Hole 🤔 #Shorts
youtube.description:
That tiny hole in airplane windows is on purpose. ✈️

It sits in the middle pane, so the outer pane carries the cabin pressure, the middle one is the backup, and the window doesn't fog.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
